player_prompt.intro:
Yin a Player {player_id} ku JoJoJoin, yikɛɛlɛn 5x5 ku cells 0-24.
Kɛɛlɛn wɛ̈ɛ̈n, tɛ̈ɛ̈n wɛ̈ɛ̈n kuɔɔn cɔɔl ɛ̈ɛ̈n, kɛ̈ɛ̈n '[12]'.
YIN A WIɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛɛlɛn FOUR wɛ̈ɛ̈n kuɔɔn cɔɔl ɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛ̈ɛ̈n, kɛ̈ɛ̈n kɛ̈ɛ̈n, ku kɛ̈ɛ̈n.
Kɛɛlɛn Player {player_id} yin a '{symbol}'; kɛɛlɛn wɛ̈ɛ̈n yin a '{opponent_symbol}'.
